fit_multi_task_lasso: fit a MultiTaskLasso model to jointly select features across multiple regression tasks
fit_lasso_independent_tasks: fit independent Lasso models per task for comparison with joint multi-task selection
generate_multi_task_regression_data: generate synthetic multi-task regression data with shared sparse feature support and sinusoidal coefficients
plot_coefficient_sparsity_spy: plot coefficient non-zero location using spy plots to compare Lasso and MultiTaskLasso feature selection
plot_coefficient_time_series: plot coefficient time series for a single feature comparing ground truth, Lasso, and MultiTaskLasso estimates
